data.one_liner: Run a Dart test multiple times based on provided parameter lists.
data.what_it_does: Wraps around Dart's test package 'group' and 'test' functions to enable running the same test function multiple times with different parameter values. Supports custom description builders, setup/tearDown hooks, and per-parameter test options.
use_when: You want to run the same test logic against multiple sets of input data without duplicating test code.
You need to specify test options like skip or testOn for individual parameters.
avoid_when: You are looking for mocking libraries, golden tests, or integration testing utilities.
strengths: Eliminates duplicate test code for parameterized test cases
Integrates seamlessly with the standard Dart test package
Supports custom description builders and async tests
weaknesses: Limited strictly to parameterizing tests within the scope of the built-in test runner wrapper
data.setup_notes: Add parameterized_test to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml.
